task_definition.task_description: Please check the living room light’s status, turn it on to 75% brightness, and then restart it. After that, find the smart lock in the living room and lock it using PIN 2468, then look up audio alternatives for the Sony XM5, add the selected AirPods to my cart, place the order with the best discount using PayPal, and finally create a medium-priority app note called “Smart Home Routine and Order Summary” with the order result and send me an alert.

user_input.query: For user u_alice, please check the status of my living room light, device ID light_living, confirm it’s on, set the brightness to 75%, and then restart it. Then look up audio alternatives for product p_sony_xm5_blk, choose the selected product p_apple_airpods, add order quantity 1 to my cart, and place the order with the best discount using paypal. Finally, create a medium-priority app note titled “Smart Home Routine and Order Summary” with the order result and send me an alert.
